title: BOF Aggregator Outreach Demo Path
openingPitch60Seconds: BOF helps organizations that already work with multiple fleets give those fleets a practical operating layer for readiness, documents, compliance follow-through, settlements support, customer intake, proof collection, and back-office workflow. Instead of building a custom platform from scratch, the aggregator can use BOF to support its fleet network and convert selected fleets into structured BOF customers through a pilot program.

demoPath5Minutes.title: Aggregator roster-rule story
demoPath5Minutes.talkTrack: Show how BOF separates available carriers from usable capacity by checking carrier, driver, equipment, customer, contract, and proof requirements.

demoPath5Minutes.title: Aggregator command center
demoPath5Minutes.talkTrack: Show network-level visibility across readiness, onboarding, claims, settlement holds, documents, and backhaul readiness.

demoPath5Minutes.title: Driver roster and records
demoPath5Minutes.talkTrack: Show driver-level readiness, qualification status, document packets, and record-specific follow-up.

demoPath5Minutes.title: Document intake workbench
demoPath5Minutes.talkTrack: Show how new driver, carrier, load, and settlement-support documents enter the BOF review workflow.

demoPath5Minutes.title: Request an Aggregator Assessment
demoPath5Minutes.talkTrack: Ask the prospect to request an Aggregator Assessment around one real network workflow so BOF can prepare a focused review.

pilot10FleetDescription: Use a 10-fleet pilot when the aggregator already has a mature network and wants a broader readiness review across multiple carrier profiles, driver records, document packets, proof requirements, claims exposure, and settlement-support needs.
pilot5FleetFallback: Use a 5-fleet readiness pilot when the group needs a smaller first proof point. Select five fleets or participating carriers with real document, readiness, proof, claims, or settlement-support friction and map the BOF workflow around those records.
safeLanguageNotes: BOF tracks document and proof requirements.
BOF helps fleets prepare cleaner operating records.
BOF supports customer intake and follow-through.
BOF provides an operating layer for aggregator networks.
